meta: Screen job applications fairly with AI: choosing by gut feeling easily rules out good people; a criteria sheet helps you score everyone the same way.

muc.title: Choosing by gut feeling
muc.text: Screening by gut feeling easily rules out good people. A criteria sheet helps you score everyone the same way.

muc.title: Criteria based on the job
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a few criteria that match the actual job, like sales experience, availability and messaging style.

muc.title: Cover details before pasting
muc.text: Before pasting applications, remove names, phone numbers, ages, photos and hometowns. It's more private and less biased.

muc.title: You make the choice
muc.text: AI scores by the criteria you set and can be wrong. Reread each application; the final choice is yours.

muc.title: A three-point criteria sheet
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a criteria sheet for one role at your shop, scoring each criterion from one to three.

thu: Ask a chatbot for a criteria sheet for one role at your shop, scoring each criterion from 1 to 3.
